supersedes.reason: The v1 run did not execute a genuine buy-and-hold baseline, opened holdout for an unqualified negative development candidate, and did not implement the declared generation progression. Its holdout must not be used for v2 tuning or acceptance.

objective: Evaluate causal, long-only BTC/USD candidates on the latest 30 complete days without selecting on a single 24-hour boundary or inspecting sealed holdout data before a development-qualified candidate is frozen.

market.selectionData: No v2 provider data, development summary, or holdout result was read before this registration.

execution.windowEnd: All positions are flat at the 24-hour boundary using that boundary's observable open; no later candle data is read.
execution.buyAndHoldBaseline: A precommitted continuously-long baseline enters the genuine sleeve at the window's first observable open and force-closes it at the boundary open, creating one genuine full-window round trip. It pays the 0.1% buy and 0.1% sell fees.

qualificationOverlay.schedule: Final ten minutes of each 24-hour window; sequential one-minute round trips in fixed even-minute slots.
qualificationOverlay.accounting: A dedicated 1% sleeve is held out at window start. Overlay profit/loss and fees are reported separately and never decide candidate signals.

windows.selection: Evaluate development-only candidates in the predeclared generation order. Freeze one qualified candidate ID before opening holdout results.

preHoldoutQualification: more positive than negative development windows after all fees and overlay trades
positive development mean and median return
positive development expectancy and profit factor greater than one
positive aggregate genuine development P&L, so qualification trades cannot establish credibility
positive development mean return at every registered offset
holdoutGate: more positive than negative windows after all fees and overlay trades
positive expectancy and profit factor greater than one
worst-window loss and max drawdown better than v1
no offset has a negative mean return and no single window contributes more than 50% of total P&L
materially beats v1 positive-window ratio by at least 5 percentage points and beats cash

expansionPolicy.rule: Only these four distinct generations may be evaluated. If no development candidate clears every pre-holdout qualification threshold, output NO WINNER without opening holdout.
